Explains the ` *` the component appends rather than repeating it. Four of five fields are required, so listing them would be longer than the mark it explains.

Released 2026-08-24 by decisions/submit-stays-mailto. The button names what pressing it does — the component fires a mailto and nothing reaches a server, so it may not say gửi. 20 of the 28 characters vi allows for a button.
The panel that replaces the form. States the real state: a draft exists in the visitor's own mail client. `đã gửi` and `đã nhận` are both false here and are forbidden by the spec.
